description: Which GLO1 loop closes over the active site: per-residue Ca displacement between the 1QIN and 1FRO ligand complexes
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
three2one={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def ca_of(pid, ch):
    t=requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.pdb",timeout=120).text
    out={}
    for L in t.splitlines():
        if L.startswith("ATOM  ") and L[12:16].strip()=='CA' and L[21]==ch and L[16] in (' ','A') and L[17:20].strip() in three2one:
            out[int(L[22:26])]=np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])])
    return out
def kabsch(P,Q):
    Pc,Qc=P-P.mean(0),Q-Q.mean(0)
    V,S,W=np.linalg.svd(Pc.T@Qc)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@W)); D=np.diag([1,1,d])
    R=V@D@W
    return Pc@R, Qc

# 1QIN = transition-state analogue (HIPC-GSH, closed); 1FRO = S-benzylglutathione (open/product-like)
A=ca_of("1QIN","A"); B=ca_of("1FRO","A")
common=sorted(set(A)&set(B))
P=np.array([A[i] for i in common]); Q=np.array([B[i] for i in common])
Pa,Qa=kabsch(P,Q)
dev=np.linalg.norm(Pa-Qa,axis=1)
print(f"Superposed 1QIN chain A onto 1FRO chain A over {len(common)} CA atoms; global RMSD = {np.sqrt((dev**2).mean()):.2f} A")
df=pd.DataFrame(dict(UniProt=[i+1 for i in common], dev=dev))
top=df.sort_values('dev',ascending=False).head(14)
print("\nResidues with the largest CA displacement between the transition-state-analogue and")
print("benzyl-glutathione complexes (the 'loop closing over the active site'):")
print(top.to_string(index=False,float_format=lambda x:f"{x:.2f}"))
seg=df[(df.UniProt>=105)&(df.UniProt<=119)]
print(f"\nMean CA displacement, deleted segment 105-119: {seg.dev.mean():.2f} A (max {seg.dev.max():.2f} A)")
print(f"Mean CA displacement, whole chain:             {df.dev.mean():.2f} A")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,3.8))
ax.plot(df.UniProt,df.dev,color='#4C78A8',lw=1.2)
ax.axvspan(105,119,color='#E45756',alpha=0.25)
ax.text(112,df.dev.max()*0.9,'deleted in\nisoform 2',ha='center',fontsize=8,color='#A33')
for p in [34,100,127,173]:
    ax.axvline(p,color='#54A24B',ls=':',lw=1)
    ax.text(p,df.dev.max()*0.98,str(p),fontsize=7,color='#2A6',ha='center')
ax.set_xlabel('UniProt residue'); ax.set_ylabel('CA displacement (A)')
ax.set_title('Conformational change between the GLO1 transition-state-analogue complex (1QIN)\n'
             'and the S-benzylglutathione complex (1FRO); green ticks mark the four zinc ligands')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
